pairs.target: yīwén bǎ nà kē xiǎo xīng túdiào le .
pairs.english: Iven rubbed out the little star.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把那颗小星涂掉了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒujìn shí , tā zhèng ná shībù cā gàoshì biānshàng de tàn yìn , yuè cā yuè huī .
pairs.english: When Tavi approached, he was wiping the charcoal mark beside the notice with a damp cloth, making it grayer and grayer.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走近时，他正拿湿布擦告示边上的炭印，越擦越灰。

pairs.target: huà xīng de shì héchàngduì de rén , tīngshuō tā yào gěi chénglǐ de kèrén jiǎng tú , biàn zài míngzì páng tiān le yìkē .
pairs.english: Someone from the choir had drawn it on hearing he would explain the map to city guests.
pairs.hanzi: 画星的是合唱队的人，听说他要给城里的客人讲图，便在名字旁添了一颗。

pairs.target: tā běnlái juéde hǎoxiào , jīntiān què bùxiǎng zài kàn .
pairs.english: He had found it funny then, but today he didn't want to see it.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来觉得好笑，今天却不想再看。

pairs.target: " búshì bú qù . " tā shuō , " bié xiàng wǒ yǐjīng dé le shénme jiǎng . "
pairs.english: “I'm not refusing to go,” he said. “Don't make it look as if I've won something already.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是不去。”他说，“别像我已经得了什么奖。”

pairs.target: liǎngtiān lái , mǐlā hé kàn wū de gōngrén yǐjīng bǎ huà duì guò .
pairs.english: Over the past two days Mira and the caretaker had compared their accounts.
pairs.hanzi: 两天来，米拉和看屋的工人已经把话对过。

pairs.target: gōngrén shuō guò búyào de kěyǐ qǔ , què méiyǒu zhǐ guò nà zuò qiáo ; tèlún chéngrèn zìjǐ méi zài wèn , réng shuō chāikāi de bùfen néng xiū huíqù .
pairs.english: He had said unwanted things could be taken, but had never pointed to the bridge; Teren admitted he hadn't asked again, though he still said the dismantled parts could be repaired.
pairs.hanzi: 工人说过不要的可以取，却没有指过那座桥；特伦承认自己没再问，仍说拆开的部分能修回去。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī yuē tāmen hòutiān xiàwǔ tán , dēngjià zànshí bú dòng .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey had arranged to meet them the afternoon after tomorrow. The lamp frame would remain untouched for now.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师约他们后天下午谈，灯架暂时不动。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ zhè shì , wèn yīwén shìbushì yě yǒurén tì tā bǎ huó xiān bào le .
pairs.english: Thinking of that, Tavi asked if someone had signed Iven up without asking too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起这事，问伊文是不是也有人替他把活先报了。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō shì zìjǐ dāying de .
pairs.english: Iven said he had volunteered.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说是自己答应的。

pairs.target: fùqīn zuótiān dào chénglǐ , dàilái kāifàngrì yào yòng de duǎnwén , tā xiǎng zhǎo tǎ wéi yìqǐ kàn .
pairs.english: His father had arrived in town yesterday with a short text for the open day, and he wanted Tavi to look at it with him.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲昨天到城里，带来开放日要用的短文，他想找塔维一起看。

pairs.target: búshì qǐng tā rènzì , shì xiǎng tīng yígè méi cānyù xiěgǎo de rén huì zěnme lǐjiě .
pairs.english: Not to have him recognize characters, but to hear how someone uninvolved in writing it would understand it.
pairs.hanzi: 不是请他认字，是想听一个没参与写稿的人会怎么理解。

pairs.target: tāmen jìn le jièzuò jiēdàishì de xiǎowū .
pairs.english: They entered the little room being used for receiving guests.
pairs.hanzi: 他们进了借作接待室的小屋。

pairs.target: chuāng biān yā zhe jǐfèn shuā hǎo de zhǐ ,
pairs.english: Several printed sheets lay weighted by the window.
pairs.hanzi: 窗边压着几份刷好的纸，

pairs.target: zuì shàngtóu yìháng bǐ zhèngwén cū , xiě zhe " běi chà duǎnxiàn jiāng tōng ".
pairs.english: The top line, heavier than the body text, read “Northfork Short Route to Open.”
pairs.hanzi: 最上头一行比正文粗，写着“北汊短线将通”。

pairs.target: xiàmiàn shuō xīnlù néng suōduǎn yùnliáng xíngchéng , yánhé zuōfang yě jiāng shòuyì , mòwěi liú le yíkuài kōng chù , zhǔnbèi tiē lù tú .
pairs.english: Below it, the new road promised shorter grain journeys and benefits for riverside workshops, with a blank space at the end for the route map.
pairs.hanzi: 下面说新路能缩短运粮行程，沿河作坊也将受益，末尾留了一块空处，准备贴路图。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú dào dìèrbiàn , cái wèn shénme shíhòu zǒu huòchē .
pairs.english: Only on his second reading did Tavi ask when freight carts would run.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读到第二遍，才问什么时候走货车。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ lìng yìzhāng zhǐ fàngzài pángbiān . nà shì nài lěi tóngyì nálái jiǎngjiě de gōngkāi chūchá zhāijì ,
pairs.english: Iven laid another sheet beside it: the public preliminary-survey extract Nerai had approved for the presentation.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把另一张纸放在旁边。那是奈蕾同意拿来讲解的公开初查摘记，

pairs.target: zhuǎnwānchù , shài wǎng yuànzi , liǎngzhǒng cǎoàn , dōu hái zài shàngmiàn .
pairs.english: The turning area, net-drying yard, and two proposals were all still there.
pairs.hanzi: 转弯处、晒网院子、两种草案，都还在上面。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi táitóu , fāxiàn yīwén děng de jiùshì zhège wèntí .
pairs.english: Tavi looked up and realized this was the question Iven had been waiting for.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维抬头，发现伊文等的就是这个问题。

pairs.target: " wǒ wèn guò xiěgǎo de . " yīwén shuō , " tā shuō jiāng tōng , búshì yǐ tōng . "
pairs.english: “I asked the writer,” Iven said. “He said 'to open,' not 'open already.'”
pairs.hanzi: “我问过写稿的。”伊文说，“他说将通，不是已通。”

pairs.target: " kě kàn wán wǒ xiǎng zhīdào jǐshí néng zǒu , búshì néng bunéng zǒu . "
pairs.english: “But after reading it, I want to know when it will open, not whether it can.”
pairs.hanzi: “可看完我想知道几时能走，不是能不能走。”

pairs.target: yīwén diǎntóu , nábǐ zài cū zì xiàmiàn huà le yìtiáoxiàn , què méi tú .
pairs.english: Iven nodded and underlined the bold heading without crossing it out.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文点头，拿笔在粗字下面划了一条线，却没涂。

pairs.target: tā fùqīn cóng lǐjiān chūlái shí , kànjiàn liǎngzhāng zhǐ bìngpái , xiān wèn tāmen chī guò méiyǒu , zài bǎ shǒulǐ de bēizi fàngxià .
pairs.english: When his father emerged from the inner room and saw the sheets side by side, he first asked if they had eaten, then set down his cup.
pairs.hanzi: 他父亲从里间出来时，看见两张纸并排，先问他们吃过没有，再把手里的杯子放下。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ wèntí shuō le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Iven explained the issue.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把问题说了一遍。

pairs.target: fùqīn méiyǒu mǎshàng fǎnbó , dītóu dúwán , shēnshǒu jiāng cū zì nà zhāng tuī zhèng , shuō zhèfèn shì zhāohū rén láikàn , búshì tōngchē gàoshì .
pairs.english: His father did not object immediately; he read both, straightened the bold-headed sheet, and said it invited people to look, not announced an opening.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲没有马上反驳，低头读完，伸手将粗字那张推正，说这份是招呼人来看，不是通车告示。

pairs.target: chūchá zuò wán , zǒngděi ràng rén zhīdào qián méi báihuā , bùnéng tóu yíjù jiù xiàng shénme yě méi bànchéng .
pairs.english: With the preliminary survey done, people needed to know the money hadn't been wasted; the opening line mustn't sound as if nothing had been accomplished.
pairs.hanzi: 初查做完，总得让人知道钱没白花，不能头一句就像什么也没办成。

pairs.target: " quèshí bànchéng le xiē shì . " yīwén shuō , " nà jiù xiě bànchéng de . "
pairs.english: “Some things have been accomplished,” Iven said. “Then write those.”
pairs.hanzi: “确实办成了些事。”伊文说，“那就写办成的。”

pairs.target: fùqīn kàn xiàng tā .
pairs.english: His father looked at him.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲看向他。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòzài yìpáng , hūrán hěn xiǎng nuókāi , yòu pà yì nuó jiù xiàng tì tā shuō dehuà tuì le yíbù .
pairs.english: Sitting beside them, Tavi suddenly wanted to move away, then feared that would look like retreating from what he had said.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐在一旁，忽然很想挪开，又怕一挪就像替他说的话退了一步。

pairs.target: tā bǎshǒu fàngzài xī shàng , tīng fùqīn wèn , àn zhèyàng xiě , shìbushì yào bǎ měiyíchù méi tántuǒ de yě yìnshàngqù .
pairs.english: He kept his hands on his knees and heard the father ask if that meant printing every unresolved detail too.
pairs.hanzi: 他把手放在膝上，听父亲问，按这样写，是不是要把每一处没谈妥的也印上去。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō búbì , kě huòchē hái bùnéng zǒu yīnggāi xiě .
pairs.english: Iven said no, but the lack of clearance for freight carts should be stated.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说不必，可货车还不能走应该写。

pairs.target: fùqīn shuō xiángtú huì jiǎng , lái de rén yě búshì zhī kàn yìháng zì .
pairs.english: His father said the detailed map would explain, and visitors wouldn't read only one line.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲说详图会讲，来的人也不是只看一行字。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngdào gàoshì qián nàxiē tíng yíxià jiù zǒu de rén , rěnbúzhù shuō yǒuxiē rén búhuì děng jiǎng tú .
pairs.english: Remembering people who stopped briefly at notices, Tavi couldn't help saying some wouldn't wait for the explanation.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想到告示前那些停一下就走的人，忍不住说有些人不会等讲图。

pairs.target: huà chūkǒu yǐhòu , tā cái yìshí dào zhè búshì zài gēn yīwén shuō .
pairs.english: Only after speaking did he realize he wasn't talking to Iven.
pairs.hanzi: 话出口以后，他才意识到这不是在跟伊文说。

pairs.target: tā fùqīn zhuǎntóu kàn tā , wèn tā gāngcái dúwán yǐwéi shì shénme . tǎ wéi bǎ zìjǐ de wèntí yòu shuō le yíbiàn , méiyǒu tiān shàng nài lěi méi shuō guò de hòuguǒ .
pairs.english: Iven's father turned and asked what he had thought it meant. Tavi repeated his question without adding consequences Nerai had never mentioned.
pairs.hanzi: 他父亲转头看他，问他刚才读完以为是什么。塔维把自己的问题又说了一遍，没有添上奈蕾没说过的后果。

pairs.target: wūlǐ ānjìngxiàlái .
pairs.english: The room grew quiet.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里安静下来。

pairs.target: fùqīn bǎ zhǐ wǎng yuǎnchù fàng , xiàng yào zhào tǎ wéi kànjiàn tā de jùlí zài kàn yìhuí .
pairs.english: His father moved the paper farther away, as though trying to see it from Tavi's distance.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲把纸往远处放，像要照塔维看见它的距离再看一回。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén tí zhe xiāngzǐ zǒuguò , jiào ménkǒu ràng yi ràng , sāngè rén què dōu méiyǒu dòng .
pairs.english: Someone carrying a box passed the window and called for space at the door, but none of the three moved.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人提着箱子走过，叫门口让一让，三个人却都没有动。

pairs.target: " nà tiān yígè nǐ zì . " fùqīn shuō .
pairs.english: “Then add 'proposed,'” his father said.
pairs.hanzi: “那添一个拟字。”父亲说。

pairs.target: yīwén ná qǐbǐ , xiěxià " nǐ kāitōng ", kàn le yíhuìer , yòu bǎ bǐ fàngxià .
pairs.english: Iven picked up his pen, wrote “proposed opening,” studied it, then put the pen down again.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文拿起笔，写下“拟开通”，看了一会儿，又把笔放下。

pairs.target: " yuànzi zěnme ānzhì hái méi dìng . xiě zhège , xiàng zhī shèng dìng rìzi . "
pairs.english: “The yard's arrangements aren't settled. That makes it sound as if only the date is left.”
pairs.hanzi: “院子怎么安置还没定。写这个，像只剩定日子。”

pairs.target: fùqīn de liǎnsè biàn le xiē , shuō tā búshì bù zhīdào zhèxiē , zhǐshì bùnéng bǎ yìzhāng yāo tiē xiěchéng zhēngyì bó .
pairs.english: His father's expression shifted. He knew all this, he said, but an invitation couldn't become a dispute ledger.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲的脸色变了些，说他不是不知道这些，只是不能把一张邀帖写成争议簿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngjiàn " yāo tiē ", cái míngbái tóng yìzhāng zhǐ zài liǎnggè rén shǒulǐ , jìng lián jiào shénme dōu bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: Hearing “invitation,” Tavi realized they didn't even call the same sheet by the same name.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听见“邀帖”，才明白同一张纸在两个人手里，竟连叫什么都不一样。

alignment.english: didn't even call the same sheet by the same name

pairs.target: yīwén shuō nà bié ràng tā zhàn zài tú páng jiǎng xiāngfǎn dehuà .
pairs.english: Iven said then he should not be made to stand beside the map saying the opposite.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说那别让他站在图旁讲相反的话。

pairs.target: tā shuō dé bǐ xiānqián xiǎng , bēizi lǐ de shuǐ qīngqīng huàng le yìquān .
pairs.english: His voice was louder than before; a ripple crossed the cup.
pairs.hanzi: 他说得比先前响，杯子里的水轻轻晃了一圈。

pairs.target: fùqīn jiào tā bǎ shēngyīn fàng dī , yīwén zhào zuò le , què méiyǒu bǎ nàjùhuà shōuhuí qù .
pairs.english: His father told him to lower his voice. Iven did, but didn't withdraw the words.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲叫他把声音放低，伊文照做了，却没有把那句话收回去。

pairs.target: guò le yíhuìer , fùqīn wèn tā xiǎng zěnme xiě .
pairs.english: After a while his father asked how he wanted it written.
pairs.hanzi: 过了一会儿，父亲问他想怎么写。

pairs.target: yīwén xiě le liǎngháng : " běi chà lùduàn chūchá , yánhé duǎntú yǔ dōngyùn cǎoàn . "
pairs.english: Iven wrote two lines: “Northfork preliminary route survey: riverside short routes and winter freight proposals.”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文写了两行：“北汊路段初查，沿河短途与冬运草案。”

pairs.target: xiàmiàn lìng xiě " huòchē tōngxíng shàngwèi hézhǔn ".
pairs.english: Below it he added “Freight-cart passage not yet approved.”
pairs.hanzi: 下面另写“货车通行尚未核准”。

pairs.target: zì tài duō , jǐchū le yuánlái de biān .
pairs.english: Too many words spilled beyond the original border.
pairs.hanzi: 字太多，挤出了原来的边。

pairs.target: fùqīn kàn wán , shuō dìèrháng búyòng tóngyàng dà , yòu shuō zhè hái dé jiāogěi fùzé kāifàngrì de rén kàn , bùnéng tāmen sāngè rén zài wūlǐ jiùsuàn gǎidìng .
pairs.english: His father said the second line needn't be equally large; the open-day organizer still had to see this, and the three of them couldn't settle it here.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲看完，说第二行不用同样大，又说这还得交给负责开放日的人看，不能他们三个人在屋里就算改定。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō kěyǐ , tā qù sòng .
pairs.english: Iven agreed and offered to deliver it.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说可以，他去送。

pairs.target: fùqīn què bǎ gǎozǐ ná qǐlái , shuō yìqǐ qù , tā bùxiǎng děngdào yìn hǎo le cái zhīdào zìjǐ guàmíng de dōngxī biànchéng shénmeyàng .
pairs.english: But his father took the draft and said they would go together; he didn't want to discover after printing what something carrying his name had become.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲却把稿子拿起来，说一起去，他不想等到印好了才知道自己挂名的东西变成什么样。

pairs.target: zhè jù huà ràng yīwén de jiānbǎng yìng le yíxià .
pairs.english: At that, Iven's shoulders stiffened.
pairs.hanzi: 这句话让伊文的肩膀硬了一下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi tāmen háiyào zhēng , fùqīn yǐjīng chuān qǐ wàiyī , huítóu jiào liǎng rén bǎ chuāng biān lìngwài jǐfèn yě dàishàng , miǎnde jiù gǎo hùnjìnqù .
pairs.english: Tavi expected more arguing, but his father was already putting on his coat and telling them to bring the remaining copies so the old draft wouldn't get mixed in.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为他们还要争，父亲已经穿起外衣，回头叫两人把窗边另外几份也带上，免得旧稿混进去。

pairs.target: fùzé de nǚ wénshū zài gébì hé míngzì .
pairs.english: The woman clerk in charge was checking names next door.
pairs.hanzi: 负责的女文书在隔壁核名字。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xīnjiù gǎo dōu shōuxià , shuō bàngwǎn qián gěi dáfù , méi dáfù búzài shuā yìn .
pairs.english: She took both drafts and promised a reply before evening; no more printing until then.
pairs.hanzi: 她把新旧稿都收下，说傍晚前给答复，没答复不再刷印。

pairs.target: fùqīn diǎntóu , réng jiānchí bié bǎ lùduàn chūchá xiě dé xiàng méi zuò ;
pairs.english: His father nodded but still insisted the preliminary survey mustn't sound unaccomplished.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲点头，仍坚持别把路段初查写得像没做；

pairs.target: yīwén dāying bǔ shàng yǐ quèrèn de bùxíng lùduàn hé dùkǒu wèizhì .
pairs.english: Iven agreed to add the confirmed walking sections and ferry location.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文答应补上已确认的步行路段和渡口位置。

pairs.target: chūménshí , fùqīn shuō wǎnshàng hái yìqǐ chīfàn . yīwén yìng le , shēngyīn píngpíng .
pairs.english: On leaving, his father said they would still eat dinner together. Iven answered in a level voice.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时，父亲说晚上还一起吃饭。伊文应了，声音平平。

pairs.target: tāmen zǒu dào yuànlǐ , tǎ wéi wèn tā shìbushì shēngqì le .
pairs.english: In the courtyard Tavi asked whether his father was angry.
pairs.hanzi: 他们走到院里，塔维问他是不是生气了。

pairs.target: " shì . " yīwén shuō , " wǒ yě yǒudiǎn shēngqì . "
pairs.english: “Yes,” Iven said. “I'm a little angry too.”
pairs.hanzi: “是。”伊文说，“我也有点生气。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn xiǎng shuō tā jiǎng dé hěn hǎo , yòu juéde nà huà tài xiàng gāngcái nàkēxīng ,
pairs.english: Tavi meant to say he had spoken well, then felt that would be too much like the star.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本想说他讲得很好，又觉得那话太像刚才那颗星，

pairs.target: biàn wèn wǎnshàng xiǎng buxiǎng ràng tā liú gè zuò . yīwén shuō jīnwǎn búyòng , míngtiān yào .
pairs.english: Instead he asked if he should save him a seat tonight. Iven said not tonight, but tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 便问晚上想不想让他留个座。伊文说今晚不用，明天要。

pairs.target: gàoshì shàng de tànhuī hái zài . yīwén kàn le yìyǎn , méiyǒu zài cā .
pairs.english: The charcoal smudge remained on the notice. Iven glanced at it and did not wipe again.
pairs.hanzi: 告示上的炭灰还在。伊文看了一眼，没有再擦。

pairs.target: tā bǎ liǎng rén yào dài qù de chūchá zhāijì zhé hǎo , biān zhé biān shuō , rúguǒ dìèrháng zhī zhǔn yìn dé hěnxiǎo , tā jiǎng de shíhòu jiù xiān niàn dìèrháng .
pairs.english: Folding the survey extract they would bring, he said if the second line had to be tiny, he would read it first in his explanation.
pairs.hanzi: 他把两人要带去的初查摘记折好，边折边说，如果第二行只准印得很小，他讲的时候就先念第二行。
